h2: Inspection equipment tracking and calibration scheduling
html:
Software reviews for inspection companies list equipment tracking and calibration scheduling as separate features, but for an NDT company they are one problem. An instrument that is in the right truck but out of calibration is as useless on site as one that was never loaded, and the client's inspector will check the calibration certificate before looking at the weld.

What inspection equipment tracking has to cover

NDT kit is varied and easy to lose: flaw detectors and thickness gauges, probes and wedges, yokes and UV-A lamps, light meters, densitometers, radiography exposure devices and survey meters, reference blocks and step wedges. Inspection equipment tracking means every item is known by serial number from arrival to disposal, with who holds it, which job it is reserved for, its condition and its stage of life: active, in calibration, in repair, rented out or retired. Issue and return are recorded, so an overdue return shows on a dashboard instead of at the next stock count.

Calibration scheduling that reaches the job

Calibration management is more than a due-date column. Each calibration record carries the certificate, the laboratory and the next due date, and the schedule has to reach the people who plan the work. In the Asset Management app, reservations line up with crew dispatch in the Team Assignments app: assigning a serial number already committed to another job is blocked, and assigning an instrument that is out of calibration warns the planner before the crew mobilises. The NDT dashboards show calibration due and overdue next to expiring technician certificates and overdue equipment returns, so one screen covers the two things auditors check most often.

Why auditors care

Every NDT report should name the instrument, probe and calibration block used. When a client or registrar asks which block was used on a weld examined months ago, the report and the equipment record answer it together, along with that block's certificate. Written practices under SNT-TC-1A and CP-189, and quality systems under ISO 9001, all expect that trace.

Connected records

Equipment sits beside the certification register for people and feeds the NDT Reports app, all inside the NDT management software. If your calibration intervals and daily verification checks are not written down, NDT audit consulting reviews them against your procedures. To see your own equipment register in the app, request a demonstration.
